bestBets.overview: Rosehill was noted as Soft 6 on Wednesday as acceptances were taken. 20 degree days later in the week can bring improvement but there are also forecast showers for Friday and Saturday. Our rail is true and we have a big field of 3YOs in the black type race of the day. A 1500m Midway is our entrance race though and we have a good sized field here as well. 3, 4, 10 are dual acceptors. ATTRACTIVENESS draws to find a lovely run just as she did here a fortnight ago. raceTips.comment: Cuban Cigar has been racing consistently and looks well suited settling just behind the speed, with enough tactical speed to secure a favourable position and build through the straight. Attractiveness has shown plenty of ability in this grade and should appreciate being able to find cover, with her finishing strength likely to come into play late. So Rebellious has enough early pace to keep himself within striking distance and can make his presence felt if he gets a smooth run throughout. Danish Prince has been competitive without quite putting the result together and should be suited by a genuine tempo, with the gelding capable of working into the finish once balanced up. The barrier draw will be important for Danish Prince as he looks to settle without covering extra ground.

Steel Will gets the nod with an in-form jockey aboard and looks well placed to control his own race from a favourable position.

Hawkner Hall has an in-form jockey on board and looks well placed to secure the right run before the pressure goes on.
